name: invoice
title: Tax invoice
for_each: select id,number from invoices where status='issued'

sections.title: Invoice
sections.sql: select v.number,v.family,v.issued_on,v.due_on,v.currency,round(v.amount_cents/100.0,2) as total,round(v.paid_cents/100.0,2) as paid,round(v.balance_cents/100.0,2) as balance_due from v_invoices v where v.id=$1

sections.title: Lessons and packages
sections.sql: select description,round(amount_cents/100.0,2) as amount from invoice_lines where invoice_id=$1 order by description

name: family-statement
title: Family statement
for_each: select distinct f.id,f.name from families f join invoices i on i.family_id=f.id

sections.title: Invoices
sections.sql: select number,issued_on,due_on,currency,round(amount_cents/100.0,2) as amount,round(paid_cents/100.0,2) as paid,round(balance_cents/100.0,2) as balance from v_invoices where family_id=$1 order by issued_on

sections.title: Payments received
sections.sql: select p.paid_on,i.number,round(p.amount_cents/100.0,2) as amount,p.method from payments p left join invoices i on i.id=p.invoice_id where p.family_id=$1 order by p.paid_on

sections.title: Prepaid hours
sections.sql: select student,name,round(minutes_left/60.0,1) as hours_left,expires_on from v_package_balance where family_id=$1

name: progress-report
title: Term progress report
for_each: select s.id,s.name from students s where s.status='active' and exists (select 1 from lesson_students ls where ls.student_id=s.id and ls.attendance is not null)

sections.title: Student
sections.sql: select s.name,s.school,s.year_level,s.goals from students s where s.id=$1

sections.title: Attendance this term
sections.sql: select service,teacher,count(*) filter (where attendance in ('present','late')) as attended,count(*) filter (where attendance like 'absent%') as missed from v_roster where student_id=$1 and on_date>=current_date-70 and attendance is not null group by service,teacher

sections.title: Teacher notes
sections.sql: select created_at::date as date,body as note from notes where student_id=$1 and kind='progress' order by created_at

name: timesheet
title: Teacher timesheet, last 14 days
for_each: select id,name from teachers where status='active'

sections.title: Lessons taught
sections.note: Each lesson counts once, however many students were in it. Unmarked lessons are not on the sheet.
sections.sql: select l.starts_at::date as date,to_char(l.starts_at,'HH24:MI') as start,l.minutes,s.name as service,lo.name as location from lessons l join services s on s.id=l.service_id join locations lo on lo.id=l.location_id where l.teacher_id=$1 and l.status='completed' and l.starts_at>=current_date-13 and l.starts_at<current_date+1 order by l.starts_at

sections.title: Total
sections.sql: select round(coalesce(sum(l.minutes),0)/60.0,2) as hours,round(t.pay_rate_cents/100.0,2) as rate,round(coalesce(sum(l.minutes),0)*t.pay_rate_cents/6000.0,2) as pay from teachers t left join lessons l on l.teacher_id=t.id and l.status='completed' and l.starts_at>=current_date-13 and l.starts_at<current_date+1 where t.id=$1 group by t.pay_rate_cents

name: safety-register
title: Child safety check register
for_each: select id,name from locations where jurisdiction is not null

sections.title: Teachers working here and their checks
sections.sql: select distinct t.name as teacher,c.kind,c.number,c.issued_on,c.expires_on,c.verified_on from lessons l join teachers t on t.id=l.teacher_id join locations lo on lo.id=l.location_id left join safety_checks c on c.teacher_id=t.id and c.jurisdiction=lo.jurisdiction where l.location_id=$1 and l.starts_at>=current_date-90 order by t.name
